scenarios.precondition: all five baseline services are ready and an acknowledged message is queryable
scenarios.injection: replace the five baseline image digests with candidate digests one workload at a time
scenarios.observable: rollout status, pre-stop failures, message offsets, image identity, and PVC identity
scenarios.abort_condition: any candidate workload misses its rollout deadline or the acknowledged message becomes unavailable
scenarios.cleanup: restore every workload to its baseline digest
scenarios.cleanup_verification: all baseline digests and the original PVC UID set are restored

scenarios.precondition: two ready Proxy replicas are spread across schedulable workers
scenarios.injection: cordon and drain one worker with the eviction API while respecting PodDisruptionBudgets
scenarios.observable: eviction response, replacement Pod UID and node, PDB state, message visibility, and PVC identity
scenarios.abort_condition: a stateful PVC is selected for deletion or both Proxy replicas become unavailable
scenarios.cleanup: uncordon the worker and wait for every workload
scenarios.cleanup_verification: the worker is schedulable and the original PVC UID set is intact

scenarios.precondition: three NameServer replicas are ready and route discovery succeeds
scenarios.injection: isolate one NameServer replica from the client namespace with a deny ingress and egress policy
scenarios.observable: isolated Pod identity, policy state, route discovery, message visibility, and recovery latency
scenarios.abort_condition: route discovery or acknowledged-message lookup exceeds the availability budget
scenarios.cleanup_verification: all three NameServer replicas are ready and route discovery succeeds

scenarios.precondition: three NameServer replicas are ready and the route cache is warm
scenarios.injection: make two of three NameServer replicas unavailable
scenarios.observable: unavailable replica count, cached-route data-plane result, fresh route failure mode, and restoration
scenarios.abort_condition: the acknowledged message is lost or restoration exceeds the scenario deadline
scenarios.cleanup: restore the NameServer StatefulSet to three replicas
scenarios.cleanup_verification: three NameServer replicas are ready and a fresh route probe succeeds

scenarios.precondition: the collector has one ready replica and the data plane is healthy
scenarios.injection: scale the OpenTelemetry collector to zero
scenarios.observable: data-plane round trip, bounded telemetry behavior, collector rollout, and SLO duration
scenarios.abort_condition: data-plane traffic fails or telemetry backpressure becomes unbounded
scenarios.cleanup: restore the collector replica count to one
scenarios.cleanup_verification: the collector is ready and the data plane remains available

scenarios.precondition: a ready stateless Proxy Pod is scheduled on a worker
scenarios.injection: taint that worker with node.kubernetes.io/disk-pressure:NoSchedule and evict the Proxy Pod
scenarios.observable: taint, replacement Pod UID and placement, message visibility, PVC identity, and node state
scenarios.abort_condition: a stateful PVC changes identity or no Proxy replica remains ready
scenarios.cleanup_verification: the node is untainted and every workload is ready

scenarios.precondition: the production LocalFileMessageStore accepts a durable write and free-space telemetry is captured
scenarios.injection: drive the production store through its disk-full running-state transition without consuming host capacity
scenarios.observable: filesystem usage, typed write rejection, acknowledged-message durability, state recovery, and post-cleanup usage
scenarios.abort_condition: an acknowledged message becomes unreadable or the injected state cannot be cleared
scenarios.cleanup: transition the production store back to disk-ok and shut it down cleanly
scenarios.cleanup_verification: new writes succeed, the acknowledged message remains readable, and the cluster Broker is ready

scenarios.precondition: the Broker PVC is writable and baseline write latency is recorded
scenarios.injection: run bounded synchronous write contention on the Broker PVC
scenarios.observable: baseline and impaired latency, timeout behavior, message offsets, and contention-process termination
scenarios.abort_condition: the acknowledged-message lookup fails or disk utilization reaches the emergency reserve
scenarios.cleanup: terminate the contention process and delete its run-scoped file
scenarios.cleanup_verification: no contention process or file remains and Broker readiness recovers

scenarios.precondition: three Controllers are ready and exactly one leader is reported
scenarios.injection: delete the current Controller leader Pod
scenarios.observable: leader identity before and after, quorum state, message visibility, and replica restoration
scenarios.abort_condition: two leaders are observed, quorum is lost, or election exceeds the deadline
scenarios.cleanup: wait for the deleted ordinal and all Controller replicas
scenarios.cleanup_verification: three Controllers are ready and exactly one different leader is reported

scenarios.precondition: three Controllers are ready and exactly one leader is reported
scenarios.injection: make two Controller replicas unavailable while retaining one replica
scenarios.observable: quorum-unavailable response, absence of duplicate leadership, data-plane behavior, and restored election
scenarios.abort_condition: the isolated replica commits a control-plane mutation or acknowledged data is lost
scenarios.cleanup: restore the Controller StatefulSet to three replicas
scenarios.cleanup_verification: three replicas are ready and exactly one leader is reported

scenarios.precondition: the Broker and both Proxy replicas are ready and baseline round-trip latency is recorded
scenarios.injection: apply bounded latency and packet loss, then reject established Broker traffic to model a half-open connection
scenarios.observable: traffic-control state, latency, loss/retry behavior, half-open timeout, message offsets, and cleanup state
scenarios.abort_condition: impairment escapes the selected worker or acknowledged data becomes unreadable
scenarios.cleanup: remove every run-scoped traffic-control and firewall rule
scenarios.cleanup_verification: no qdisc/firewall marker remains and workloads recover

scenarios.precondition: three controller-mode Brokers are ready with one master and at least one synchronized replica
scenarios.injection: delay HA replication traffic to one replica, write an acknowledged probe, and remove the current master
scenarios.observable: replication lag, acknowledged offset, promoted Broker identity, RPO, RTO, and restored membership
scenarios.abort_condition: the acknowledged probe is absent after promotion or more than one master is observed
scenarios.cleanup: remove replication delay and restore all Broker replicas
scenarios.cleanup_verification: one master, synchronized replicas, zero acknowledged-message loss, and all Brokers ready

scenarios.precondition: Controller state has advanced beyond a recorded snapshot boundary
scenarios.injection: restart a lagging follower while it is installing a Raft snapshot
scenarios.observable: snapshot transfer attempt, interrupted follower state, checksum/replay result, leader identity, and catch-up
scenarios.abort_condition: the follower applies a corrupt snapshot, leadership duplicates, or committed state regresses
scenarios.cleanup: allow the follower to restart and complete snapshot installation
scenarios.cleanup_verification: the follower catches up, checksum validation passes, and one leader remains

scenarios.precondition: both Proxy replicas are ready and admission metrics start below every configured bound
scenarios.injection: hold a long poll against an impaired Broker while issuing unrelated sends until admission overload is reached
scenarios.observable: long-poll duration, unrelated-send progress, FIFO order, bounded inflight/items/bytes, typed overload, and shutdown diagnostics
scenarios.abort_condition: an unrelated send stalls beyond its deadline or queue budgets exceed their hard limits
scenarios.cleanup: remove Broker impairment and let every admitted request drain or cancel
scenarios.cleanup_verification: all permits return and leaked and detached task counts are zero

scenarios.precondition: baseline credentials authorize an acknowledged-message query
scenarios.injection: atomically replace projected runtime ACL material and wait for the Broker file watcher to hot reload it
scenarios.observable: semantic old/new credential results, rollback result, unchanged Broker pod identities, and redaction scan
scenarios.abort_condition: credential projection does not converge before the deadline, Broker pods restart, or a secret value is emitted
scenarios.cleanup: restore the baseline projected secret and wait for the Broker file watcher to hot reload it
scenarios.cleanup_verification: baseline credentials work, rotated credentials are rejected, Broker pod identities are unchanged, and generated evidence contains no secret value

scenarios.precondition: a successful send acknowledgement and both durable offsets have been recorded
scenarios.injection: restart the Broker after recording the successful send acknowledgement
scenarios.observable: message identity, queue and commit-log offsets, PVC identity, and Broker recovery
scenarios.abort_condition: message identity or either durable offset changes
scenarios.cleanup: wait for the Broker StatefulSet to become ready
scenarios.cleanup_verification: the same unique key and offsets are queryable on the original PVC
